# Dollars & Deductions

> Plain-English guides to small-business taxes, entity structure, deductions, bookkeeping, and payroll — written for owners, not accountants. Educational content only: not tax, legal, or financial advice. We are not CPAs or tax advisors and do not claim to be. The site is reader-supported through partner referral fees, disclosed on every monetized page.

## Start here

- [S Corp vs LLC (2026): How the Tax Choice Actually Works](https://dollarsanddeductions.com/s-corp-vs-llc/): the highest-traffic question in small-business tax, answered without a sales pitch
- [Small Business Tax Deductions: The Categories That Matter](https://dollarsanddeductions.com/small-business-tax-deductions/): home office, vehicle, retirement, health insurance, startup costs
- [Small Business Tax Deductions Checklist](https://dollarsanddeductions.com/small-business-tax-deductions-checklist/): year-end and year-round checklist
- [How Much Does a CPA Cost?](https://dollarsanddeductions.com/how-much-does-a-cpa-cost/): pricing models and what drives the price
- [How Much Does a CPA Cost for a Small Business?](https://dollarsanddeductions.com/how-much-does-a-cpa-cost-for-a-small-business/): bundled services and the DIY-vs-pro breakpoint
- [What Is a Tax Strategist?](https://dollarsanddeductions.com/what-is-a-tax-strategist/): what they do, how they differ from preparers, when hiring one pays off
